RoselineMCP

RoselineMCP Documentation

Welcome to the RoselineMCP documentation! RoselineMCP is a high-performance MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that provides comprehensive code analysis and automated fixing capabilities for C# solutions using Roslyn analyzers and code fix providers.

🎯 Key Features

Comprehensive Code Analysis

Analyze entire C# solutions for code quality issues, potential bugs, and style violations with powerful filtering options.

Automated Code Fixes

Apply automated fixes for hundreds of diagnostic rules from Roslyn and Roslynator with preview capabilities.

Multi-Architecture Docker Support

Deploy RoselineMCP as a Docker container with support for both x64 and ARM64 architectures.

MCP Protocol Integration

Full integration with the Model Context Protocol for seamless AI assistant usage.

🔧 Available Tools

Tool Description
AnalyzeSolution Analyzes entire C# solutions for diagnostics with filtering options
ListDiagnostics Gets detailed diagnostics for specific projects with statistics
ApplyFixes Applies automated code fixes for specified diagnostic IDs
CreatePatch Generates unified diff patches between text versions

📦 Supported Analyzers

  • Roslyn Analyzers - Built-in C# compiler diagnostics
  • Roslynator - 500+ analyzers, refactorings, and fixes
  • StyleCop Analyzers - Code style and consistency rules
  • Custom Analyzers - Any Roslyn-based analyzer in your solution
